YOUR SOUND STUDIO

Set the mood.

♫

The smallest value in this dataset plays your lowest note, the biggest plays your highest note.

Synthesized instrument sounds. Warmer, brighter or stormier → higher notes. Every step gets the same amount of time. “How the sound is made” below shows the exact rule for this dataset. Musical scales round pitch; the chart always shows the original values.

HOW THE SOUND IS MADE

From numbers to notes

LISTEN WITH CONTEXT

A rising note tells a story.

Each note is one year’s global temperature anomaly. Positive means warmer than the 1951–1980 average; negative means cooler. These are global averages, not temperatures in a particular city.

    Your next listening chapter.

    The night lights and lightning numbers come from NASA Earth Information Center movies (Scientific Visualization Studio 5313 and 5011). We read the color of every frame and turned it into numbers, then checked them: NASA’s change map and our own year-by-year comparison agree on “brighter or darker” in 92% of areas. Sound is generated live in your browser.
